shortDescription: A 4-day powerlifting system combining Max Effort heavy singles, Dynamic Effort speed work, and high-volume accessories to build strength year-round.
descriptionHtml: A 4-day powerlifting system combining Max Effort heavy singles, Dynamic Effort speed work, and high-volume accessories to build strength year-round.
author: Louie Simmons

exercises.notes: Work up to a heavy 1-3RM, then one backoff AMRAP at ~70%.
